original.target_description: Miller and Ratner (1998), Study 1: 56 undergraduate participants; one-sample t test comparing each participant’s predicted effect of payment on peers’ willingness to donate blood with the actual effect of payment on willingness to donate blood.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants contributing estimates to the Study 1 overestimation t test (df = 55).
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this test; reported participant count and test degrees of freedom agree.
n.location: Published p. 54 (PDF p. 2), Method—Participants; Results and Discussion—Actual Versus Estimated Impact of Self-Interest; footnote 2.

replication.target_description: Study 1, Hypothesis 1A, combined MTurk and Prolific samples: one-sample t-test of overestimation of the paid-minus-unpaid blood-donation willingness difference against zero; Table 5 combined row.

n.sample_role: Participants in the combined Study 1 overestimation analysis (799 MTurk and 799 Prolific).
n.exclusions: One MTurk participant reporting age 11 excluded from 800; Prolific completed sample 799. Planned exclusions concerned English proficiency and understanding; no further exclusions identified for this test.
n.location: Table 5, Combined row, n column; Participants and Overview, MTurk and Prolific subsections

es.location: Study 1 Results, Hypothesis 1A (combined samples); Table 5, Combined row
es.quote: the one-sample t-test against μ = 0 for overestimation was t(1597) = 23.1, p < .0001, d = 0.58 [0.53, 0.63].

p.location: Study 1 Results, Hypothesis 1A (combined samples), one-sample overestimation test against zero

reported_success.quote: Study 1 provided evidence for an overestimation of financial self-interest in willingness to donate blood.

notes:
Replication cache title verified against supplied reference. Selected the direct overestimation test against zero corroborated by Table 5, not the separate discrepancy test in the same paragraph (printed t(1598) = 33.85, d = 0.85, p < .001). Locator p.16 cannot be mapped exactly in the unpaginated cached parse; Study 1/Hypothesis 1A and Table 5 identify the outcome and test. Original acquisition: DOI landing page returned 403 and was not retried; Unpaywall supplied no OA location; OpenAlex supplied no full-text location; Europe PMC had no PMC/full text; author publication page supplied no PDF; OSF project resource listing supplied preregistration archives but no original paper. Original values are not copied from the replication article.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-side extraction from the supplied published scanned article. Title and target statistics visually verified against the PDF. The target is predicted versus actual payment-related change (t = 7.94), distinct from the adjacent predicted paid-versus-unpaid comparison (t = 12.38). Footnote 2 identifies comparison of each participant’s estimate with the actual impact. Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
